cohort: Pregnant women with viable pregnancies (beyond 28 weeks of gestation) admitted to the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology at pt J.N.M Medical College & Dr Bhim Rao Ambedkar Medical Hospital Raipur.
finding: Oligohydramnios (AFI < 5cm) was significantly associated with adverse maternal and perinatal outcomes, including IUGR, low term birth weight, low 1-minute Apgar scores, abnormal liquor color, NICU admission, and neonatal death.
birth_weight: Measured as an outcome, but specific weights of included babies were not specified as inclusion criteria.
